## Pre-registered effects (arm full)

1. Maximum block span >= 20: 106.3 -> **holds**.
2. First session with span >= 80 in [250, 865]: per seed [759, 606, 608] -> **holds**; span at 865 99.1 [97.6-101.9] (DD 104).
3. 4-digit error > 3-digit error (250-865): 0.056 vs 0.029 -> **holds** (EPAM 3.0% vs 1.5%).
4. Prior speeds early learning (span s50 full vs prioroff): 11.1 vs 8.9 -> **holds**.
5. Letter probe final <= 9 at every probe: max 11 -> **fails**.
- linkoff: span s865 full vs linkoff per seed [('97.7', '41.7'), ('101.9', '41.6'), ('97.6', '43.2')] -> full beats it on every seed: **True**.
- conceptsoff: span s865 full vs conceptsoff per seed [('97.7', '70.0'), ('101.9', '70.7'), ('97.6', '74.9')] -> full beats it on every seed: **True**.
